items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was a good friend of mine, Boogie Martin.

ctx.x: No. That was a good friend of mine, Boogie Martin. I remember him. A week later, he brought the 15 bucks back. Wanted to borrow a mouthpiece, this-that-and-the-other. We became good friends. He’s still alive. I talked to him about three months ago. He’s lost a lung and so forth. But we got to laughing about old times, and I realized how important it is to dredge up some of those memories, for each person, to kind of relive it. Because we’re all reaching the end. It’s getting closer and closer.
